about_the_game:
«Campfire Stories: The Giant of Green Peaks» is an atmospheric horror inspired by the suspense of «Slender: The Arrival» and the meditative dread of «Dear Esther». Cinematic landscapes, realistic forest sounds, and an overwhelming sense of being lost pull you into a classic tale of Pacific Northwest folklore — where the most infamous forest cryptid becomes your silent pursuer.

Step into a campfire story made real: where Green Peaks’ unsolved mysteries turn you from hiking to hunted. Waking up deep within Green Peaks Reserve, your only choice is to run away: through the misty forest, along the black-water lake, hiding behind the ancient pines. With every step, you feel it: someone… or something is watching you.

Features:

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Explore in first person the classic campfire story. Escape the misty forest and survive the encounter with a famous cryptid.

  • Environmental Storytelling: Show, don't tell! Carefully crafted environment tells the story for you to see.

  • Survival: Your only option is to hide. There is no fighting back the monster that lives deep in the woods.

Out Summer 2025 | PC (Steam)
